data.gender_notes: Devurvansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Devurvansh is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Deva' (God) and 'Vansh' (lineage). This name signifies someone who is part of the divine lineage or descended from gods. The name Devurvansh carries the meaning “God's lineage” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Devurvansh usually hope their child will grow to embody god's lineage and live with faith, good character and purpose.
